newsitem.title: USA: 1st Bergen Bancorp says to buy back stock.
newsitem.headline: 1st Bergen Bancorp says to buy back stock.

text.p: 1st Bergen Bankcorp said on Monday its directors had adopted a stock buyback program, under which the company will repurchase five percent of its common stock to enhance shareholder value.
The stock will be bought in open market and privately negotiated purchases, the company said in a statement.
1st Bergen has already received clearance from the Office of Thrift Supervision to commence the buyback program, the company said.
The announcement followed an April 2 announcement that 1st Bergen would repurchase up to four percent of its common stock under two separate management recognition and retention plans.
1st Bergen is the holding company for South Bergen Savings Bank, which operates a community thrift business.
The Bank also said it anticipates opening a fourth branch in Lincroft, New Jersey, in the second quarter 1997.
